name: novel-characters
description: Construct causal character bibles and relationship state in provider-safe structured batches.
procedure: Give each major character conflicting wants, needs, beliefs, secrets, and leverage.
Connect personal change to causal plot pressure and relationship state.
Persist character bibles in batches of at most three operations per applyArtifactBatch call with stable keys.
Continue until the target ensemble is persisted; relationship-graph work remains a separate task.
